subject: Cannot login to account
description: I have been unable to log into my account for the past two days and need urgent help resetting it.

subject: Password reset email not arriving
description: I requested a password reset over an hour ago but the email has not arrived in my inbox.

subject: Account locked after failed attempts
description: My account was locked after three failed login attempts and I cannot get back into it.

subject: Two-factor authentication code rejected
description: My 2FA code is being rejected even though I am using the correct authenticator app.

subject: Application crashes on startup
description: The application crashes every single time I try to open it on my Windows 11 machine.

subject: 500 internal server error on checkout
description: I get a 500 internal server error every time I try to complete a purchase on the platform.

subject: API timeout on bulk requests
description: Our integration keeps getting timeout errors when sending more than ten API requests per second.

subject: Search results not loading at all
description: The search page spins indefinitely and never returns results for any query I enter in the box.

subject: Double charge on monthly subscription
description: I was charged twice for my monthly subscription this billing cycle and need a full refund immediately.

subject: Invoice total does not match items
description: The invoice total does not match the line items listed and I need a corrected invoice for accounting.

subject: No refund received after cancellation
description: I cancelled my subscription two weeks ago but have still not received my refund yet.

subject: Unauthorized charge on credit card
description: There is an unexpected charge from your service on my credit card that I did not authorize.

subject: Please add a dark mode theme
description: It would be great to have a dark mode theme option available in the application user settings.

subject: Export reports to PDF format
description: Please add the ability to export reports and tickets to PDF format for our offline records.

subject: Allow bulk ticket assignment
description: It would improve workflow significantly to allow assigning multiple tickets to agents at once.

subject: Increase API rate limits for enterprise
description: Our integration would benefit greatly from higher API rate limits available on the enterprise plan.

subject: Dashboard ticket count is wrong
description: The ticket count shown on the dashboard is incorrect. Steps to reproduce: open dashboard and compare the count to the list.

subject: Sorting by date shows random order
description: Sorting tickets by date shows results in a completely random order. Steps to reproduce: click the date column header.

subject: Applied filters reset on page refresh
description: Applied filters are lost when the page is refreshed. Steps to reproduce: set a filter then refresh the page.

subject: Duplicate email notifications sent
description: Users receive duplicate email notifications for the same event. Steps to reproduce: update a ticket status and check inbox.
